writer_policy: Writers emit only the current schemas listed here.
reader_policy: Readers fail closed on legacy, incomplete, mixed-provenance, identity-mismatched, or reordered evidence and never guess missing provenance.

schemas.identity_rules: Exact STSRL code commit, native fee272f1 commit, source manifest/verifier hashes, CMake-selected Python executable and runner extension suffix, runtime API/geometry checks executed by that Python against that build root, and t070-native-runtime-identity-v1 extension hash/size/path/Python ABI must all match at every consumer.
schemas.ordering: commands and return_codes preserve verifier, runtime configure, runtime build, runtime API smoke, and runtime geometry order; required_apis is published order.
schemas.missingness: No required field is nullable; a missing runtime identity, runtime acceptance result/log, command result, or build identity invalidates Stage 0.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; no migration or inferred native provenance.

schemas.identity_rules: All consumed file hashes and bytes, exact code/native commits, and the complete stage tuple inventory are immutable after freeze.
schemas.ordering: Primary and high-budget stage inventories use the task-published order; shard ranges are contiguous and ordered exactly as published.
schemas.missingness: No missing input identity, stage tuple, range, or worker topology is allowed.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; frozen values cannot be migrated or retuned after outcomes.

schemas.identity_rules: Exactly the ten frozen primary stages, one shared baseline, one 93-record cohort, and one runtime identity contribute; mixed provenance fails.
schemas.ordering: Families are equal_nominal, simulator_step_normalized, wall_clock_normalized; each has baseline, prior_only, value_only, prior_value and overall, boss_only, act2_plus cells in published order.
schemas.missingness: Every 93/88/5 cell, paired bootstrap interval, structured resource row, action identity, compute value, and all nine explicit failure counts are required; unavailable values make command_passed false.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 report and t070-search-v2-primary-arm-cell-v1 cells only; legacy T062/T069 summaries are inputs, not substitutable outputs.

schemas.identity_rules: Records retain canonical complete source identities and map exactly to five Act-2+ plus eleven Boss-only sources from the frozen T052 cohort.
schemas.ordering: Act-2+ records precede Boss-only records; within selection, canonical SHA-256 ordering and new cohort indices 0 through 15 are exact.
schemas.missingness: All 16 source identities, structural strata, hashes, and selection proof fields are required; outcome-derived fields are forbidden rather than nullable.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; selection cannot be rebuilt with outcome-bearing or guessed identities.

schemas.identity_rules: Exactly six frozen high-budget stages over the same ordered 16-record subset and one runtime identity contribute.
schemas.ordering: Arms are baseline then prior_value; budgets are 100, 400, 1600; record rows remain subset-index ordered.
schemas.missingness: All six outcome/compute cells and both paired comparisons are required; an invalid stage leaves diagnostic flags uncomputed and command_passed false.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 report and t070-search-v2-high-budget-arm-cell-v1 cells only; high-budget evidence cannot replace primary promotion evidence.

schemas.identity_rules: Geometry comes only from prior_value companion-API stages at budgets 100, 400, 1600 on the frozen subset; native schema and parity invariants are exact.
schemas.ordering: Budgets ascend 100, 400, 1600; records use subset indices 0 through 15; depth rows and branch histograms use ascending depth/branch factor.
schemas.missingness: Every record/budget needs raw native geometry plus all specified derived metrics; a missing or malformed row invalidates the report.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; metrics describe exposed-edge coverage and must not be relabeled global game-tree coverage.

schemas.identity_rules: Decision consumes only the valid primary, budget-curve, and geometry reports from the same frozen experiment identity.
schemas.ordering: Truth-table priority is A before B before C; no secondary recommendation is emitted.
schemas.missingness: Any incomplete required evidence prevents a decision artifact; Boolean diagnostic values are never inferred.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 truth table only; T070 recommends but never publishes a successor.

schemas.identity_rules: Exactly 16 stage reports bind exact code/native/runtime identities, frozen stage tuple, cohort/checkpoint hashes, 16 workers, and exact ranges.
schemas.ordering: Ten primary stages precede six high-budget stages; each worker list is index/range ordered from 0 through 15.
schemas.missingness: Every stage and worker command, return code, runtime identity, log path, range, wall time, and merged artifact is required; no lower-worker fallback.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; stage reports with legacy, mixed, or absent runtime provenance fail closed.

schemas.identity_rules: Every retained file records absolute path, SHA-256, bytes, schema when JSON, exact source identities, per-file regeneration command, compatibility, retention reason, consumer, and deletion condition.
schemas.ordering: retained_artifacts are absolute-path sorted; regeneration command kinds are preflight, freeze, stage, finalize.
schemas.missingness: No listed path or per-file provenance/command/retention field may be absent; non-JSON logs use explicit null schema_id.
schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; raw deletion is forbidden until the recorded conditions are satisfied.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: The imported extension must reside under the declared fresh build root inside the exact fee272f1 tracked-clean source checkout and match its retained hash, size, and interpreter ABI.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Scalar identity object; field serialization is canonical key order.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: No field is nullable; unavailable ABI or extension provenance invalidates the runtime.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; extension substitution or path/hash drift fails closed.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: One frozen family/arm/stratum cell retains exact ordered cohort indices and pairs only against its shared baseline.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Cohort-index ascending for HP, resources, potions, and occurrence-safe action rows.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: Every expected 93/88/5 row and all nine failure counters are explicit; absent values invalidate the cell.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 cell only; no scalarization of structured outcomes.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: One frozen arm/budget cell contains exactly the same 16 subset identities and runtime as every other curve cell.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Subset-index ascending; budgets are ordered by the parent curve.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: All 16 outcomes, compute values, action identities, resources, and explicit failure counts are required.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 diagnostic cell only; cannot substitute for primary evidence.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: One worker binds one frozen stage tuple, exact range, code/native/runtime, cohort, checkpoint-bearing controller provenance, and output.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Records remain cohort-index ascending within the contiguous shard range.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: No identity, range, provenance, report, or success field may be absent.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; mixed worker identities fail merge.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: Exactly 16 same-identity shards cover the ordered cohort once with no gaps or duplicates.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Shard paths/ranges and merged records are worker/cohort-index ascending.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: All 16 shards and every expected record are required; any problem makes command_passed false.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; no partial or lower-worker merge.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: One detail report binds a frozen stage and all 16 worker runtime identities to the same preflight.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Workers and ranges are index ordered 0 through 15.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: Every worker command, return code, runtime identity, range, and log path is required.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current detail v1 only; the aggregate t070-stage-execution-v1 is a distinct schema.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: One prior_value search decision retains the validated native-battle-search-v2-tree-geometry-v1 payload and occurrence-safe selected root action.
supplemental_schemas.ordering: Decision steps, root actions/visits, native depth rows, and histograms preserve native canonical order.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: All geometry, root, selection, and compute fields are required whenever tree geometry is enabled.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; geometry-disabled decisions omit the record rather than emit partial data.

supplemental_schemas.identity_rules: Each relative log path is paired with exact SHA-256 and byte size under the reproduction root.
supplemental_schemas.missingness: Every produced preflight and worker stdout/stderr log is indexed; logs are not copied.
supplemental_schemas.compatibility: Current v1 only; the index is a lightweight locator and does not replace retained raw logs.
